pokedexEntries.bk: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

pokedexEntries.wh: Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

pokedexEntries.sc: When Pignite enters battle, its body temperature rapidly soars until Pignite itself is engulfed by a scorching fireball.

pokedexEntries.vi: When defending its friends, Pignite will stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong. But it’s powerless when faced with an empty stomach.
